# [0.27.0](https://github.com/abogartz/opencode-self-improvement/compare/v0.26.1...v0.27.0) (2026-11-17)


### Bug Fixes

* **recall:** count whole-word concepts in the gate, not substrings ([79c2d8e](https://github.com/abogartz/opencode-self-improvement/commit/79c2d8e7212a04f011e2559f05cfae2a70ef6167))


### Features

* **recall:** two-concept admission for memory_recall behind a flag ([ac593c0](https://github.com/abogartz/opencode-self-improvement/commit/ac593c07c604616c39bafb5daa25031538fdd504)), closes [#409](https://github.com/abogartz/opencode-self-improvement/issues/409) [#409](https://github.com/abogartz/opencode-self-improvement/issues/409)

## [0.26.1](https://github.com/abogartz/opencode-self-improvement/compare/v0.26.0...v0.26.1) (2026-11-17)


### Bug Fixes

* **bench:** recall-quality emits the fixtures/ path it moved to in 5e83025 — a re-run reverted the summary header ([08ee74b](https://github.com/abogartz/opencode-self-improvement/commit/08ee74b9b99ecf5a675996470ebda3eb32497dac))
* **recall:** clamp the limit, and price the window cut per query ([2961a7e](https://github.com/abogartz/opencode-self-improvement/commit/2961a7ebbd4c1977e0128e2ec67928931a707158)), closes [#415](https://github.com/abogartz/opencode-self-improvement/issues/415)
* **recall:** default the memory_recall window to 5 rows, not 20 ([#409](https://github.com/abogartz/opencode-self-improvement/issues/409)) ([3a23ee3](https://github.com/abogartz/opencode-self-improvement/commit/3a23ee38c8c90e254091f70b197470aa3153b88c))
* **recall:** keep the whole identifier as a token alongside its segments ([8c2df14](https://github.com/abogartz/opencode-self-improvement/commit/8c2df1431946d8eca0ce6c63d7cd2349884aaf90))
* **recall:** trim edge punctuation; admission counts concepts, not tokens ([359428b](https://github.com/abogartz/opencode-self-improvement/commit/359428b0ae8c7c7fa53be28dce28c2f0edae0ec8)), closes [#417](https://github.com/abogartz/opencode-self-improvement/issues/417)


### Performance Improvements

* **recall:** split identifiers in the matcher tokenizer ([#409](https://github.com/abogartz/opencode-self-improvement/issues/409)) ([00dac47](https://github.com/abogartz/opencode-self-improvement/commit/00dac47d55874841a3a7029cecfa0e58f0d8d531))

# [0.26.0](https://github.com/abogartz/opencode-self-improvement/compare/v0.25.0...v0.26.0) (2026-11-17)


### Bug Fixes

* **recall:** dedup compares content, keeps the newest, never eats a negation ([fc59b84](https://github.com/abogartz/opencode-self-improvement/commit/fc59b847a43aa4e75764ed6a5e382d1b7b055e32))
* **recall:** rows differing only by a short chunk are never copies ([1536a6d](https://github.com/abogartz/opencode-self-improvement/commit/1536a6d1e96c7b4d468b9712acb68fee970551e9))


### Features

* **recall:** suppress near-duplicates inside a memory_recall window ([#409](https://github.com/abogartz/opencode-self-improvement/issues/409)) ([3ff96ef](https://github.com/abogartz/opencode-self-improvement/commit/3ff96ef1b4daa60a4d7521688b49dfeaf129c49f))

# [0.25.0](https://github.com/abogartz/opencode-self-improvement/compare/v0.24.2...v0.25.0) (2026-11-14)


### Bug Fixes

* **bench:** measure the ceiling on the rows the arms hold, and make the gate cases use a real gate ([#402](https://github.com/abogartz/opencode-self-improvement/issues/402)) ([03e00df](https://github.com/abogartz/opencode-self-improvement/commit/03e00df62d3aa9d1dec3f7fec80bb77f02ce54dc))
* **capture:** report availability verdicts and tagged rows as two numbers ([#403](https://github.com/abogartz/opencode-self-improvement/issues/403)) ([91c0f17](https://github.com/abogartz/opencode-self-improvement/commit/91c0f175e7ae0004db0939a4fc9cdba1e67f397b))
* **capture:** stop teardown abandoning a capture pass that already answered ([#404](https://github.com/abogartz/opencode-self-improvement/issues/404)) ([e12c8a3](https://github.com/abogartz/opencode-self-improvement/commit/e12c8a359a6eebf837b58b52d25e1fb76f9f9f04)), closes [#211](https://github.com/abogartz/opencode-self-improvement/issues/211)
* **capture:** stop the polarity union adding tags, and give `restatable` a lifecycle ([#403](https://github.com/abogartz/opencode-self-improvement/issues/403)) ([05482ba](https://github.com/abogartz/opencode-self-improvement/commit/05482ba378e950a5e8aecb3d8bcef9d80e3c69fe)), closes [#397](https://github.com/abogartz/opencode-self-improvement/issues/397)
* **capture:** veto a warning that quotes a claim, and scrub the logged span before it is lowercased ([#403](https://github.com/abogartz/opencode-self-improvement/issues/403)) ([2932672](https://github.com/abogartz/opencode-self-improvement/commit/2932672f4c21fa8df99b35eda950a41ab124e444))


### Features

* **capture:** tag restatable rows instead of dropping them ([#402](https://github.com/abogartz/opencode-self-improvement/issues/402)) ([5780d8c](https://github.com/abogartz/opencode-self-improvement/commit/5780d8cd1b55083d5f86d82a003700cdc2fdfe34)), closes [#389](https://github.com/abogartz/opencode-self-improvement/issues/389) [#397](https://github.com/abogartz/opencode-self-improvement/issues/397) [#397](https://github.com/abogartz/opencode-self-improvement/issues/397)
* **capture:** the [#389](https://github.com/abogartz/opencode-self-improvement/issues/389) availability gate, as shipped by [#397](https://github.com/abogartz/opencode-self-improvement/issues/397) ([2fe2287](https://github.com/abogartz/opencode-self-improvement/commit/2fe22871f4a398a4872b3e2d453f42cb14b2372b)), closes [#402](https://github.com/abogartz/opencode-self-improvement/issues/402)

## [0.24.2](https://github.com/abogartz/opencode-self-improvement/compare/v0.24.1...v0.24.2) (2026-11-14)


### Bug Fixes

* **store:** lock each store file, not the store directory ([#407](https://github.com/abogartz/opencode-self-improvement/issues/407)) ([e145bfd](https://github.com/abogartz/opencode-self-improvement/commit/e145bfd5e2291e2ffa6f03aacf08b0776cf554d3))
* **store:** make the store lock a SQLite WAL transaction ([#407](https://github.com/abogartz/opencode-self-improvement/issues/407)) ([7bfdf9c](https://github.com/abogartz/opencode-self-improvement/commit/7bfdf9c81533ce73a8696002c58d89cbcb0ab2aa))
* **store:** rollback journal mode for the lock database ([#407](https://github.com/abogartz/opencode-self-improvement/issues/407)) ([09892ac](https://github.com/abogartz/opencode-self-improvement/commit/09892accac4e6695495ed7f61e64cd456d27abca))
* **store:** the lock budget must outlast two honest handover retries ([#407](https://github.com/abogartz/opencode-self-improvement/issues/407)) ([6aab5d9](https://github.com/abogartz/opencode-self-improvement/commit/6aab5d9702db8e9ac075215292d5a29a1fd45454))
* **test:** pin the holding premise in the cross-process lock test ([#407](https://github.com/abogartz/opencode-self-improvement/issues/407)) ([6d3bd85](https://github.com/abogartz/opencode-self-improvement/commit/6d3bd851cc27ad5e6ea3037b3bf541a852cb568d))
* **test:** wait for the promoted row, never guess a sleep ([#407](https://github.com/abogartz/opencode-self-improvement/issues/407)) ([e64eb2b](https://github.com/abogartz/opencode-self-improvement/commit/e64eb2bf1e2bbc74de6fe0db7ac9a2176676196f))
